, Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated language forms, claiming the surname derives from “Vulgar Latin (later known as Ecclesiastical Latin).” Vulgar Latin is the colloquial speech that evolved into the Romance languages, whereas Ecclesiastical (Medieval/Church) Latin is the learned register used in the 9th century. The sources only supported “Latin” (silvestris) and did not justify reclassifying it as Vulgar Latin or asserting it was later called Ecclesiastical Latin, leading to an incorrect final answer.
